pages.title: IRON NEST Punchcards - 33 Cards, Costs & Uses Explained
pages.description: Compare 33 punchcards: 21 shell records and 10 abilities with costs, use limits and unlock rules; 3 Spotter variants stay merged to avoid thin duplicate pages.
pages.source_unique_value_statement: 用一张表拆清33条正式打孔卡中的21条炮弹型记录与10个独立能力，并比较能力成本、使用次数和解锁条件；Spotter的3个源变体保留但不膨胀成薄页。
